description: Fetch the accounts that reposted one post, about 20 a page, each with its counts and bio. X's API calls this "retweeted by". Give exactly one of `url` or `id`. Costs 13 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.
